answer: Each agent posts an 80-credit bond and files a promised epoch in a crystal ledger; the auditor checks a mirror record of it. A 25-credit fee is sunk per identity, so the kth fake still pays 105, with no shared bond or mirror record. Lateness is the delta between promised and actual finish: each late epoch deducts 30, and a delta of three burns the bond. 1,000 fakes cost 105,000, plus 60,000 if each runs two epochs late. A rented-crew ring fails: one crew cannot finish a thousand jobs on time. An honest agent pays once, finishes on time, and recovers the bond after a clean epoch.
